name: diffgraph.model
summary: Defines data models for representing code modules, symbols, and dependencies in a dependency graph.

symbols.name: Dependency
symbols.signature: class Dependency(name: str, fqn: str, usage: str, file_path: str = '')
symbols.summary: Represents an annotated directed edge from a module to one of its dependencies.

symbols.name: Symbol
symbols.signature: class Symbol(name: str, kind: str, signature: str, summary: str, annotations: list[str], start_line: int, end_line: int, is_changed: bool = False, full_code: Optional[str] = None)
symbols.summary: Represents a code symbol (method, class, field, etc.) within a module.

symbols.name: Module
symbols.signature: class Module(id: str, name: str, lang: str, summary: str, symbols: list[Symbol], dependencies: list[Dependency])
symbols.summary: Represents a code module with its metadata, symbols, and dependencies.

symbols.name: MetaModel
symbols.signature: class MetaModel(modules: dict[str, Module] = field(default_factory=dict), changed_module_ids: list[str] = field(default_factory=list))
symbols.summary: Represents the complete dependency graph containing all modules and provides methods for analysis.

symbols.name: add
symbols.summary: Adds a Module to the MetaModel's collection.

symbols.name: compute_depths
symbols.summary: Performs BFS from changed modules to compute dependency depths and identifies callers.

symbols.name: to_json
symbols.summary: Serializes the graph to a JSON-serializable list of module dictionaries.

name: cli
summary: Provides a command-line interface for DiffGraph to build dependency metamodels from git diffs.

dependencies.name: DiffGraph
dependencies.usage: Instantiated to build the dependency metamodel from the diff and repository path.

dependencies.name: DiffResult
dependencies.usage: Return type of parse_diff and used to summarize and process diff information.

dependencies.name: Live
dependencies.usage: Used as a parameter type for _make_event_handler and to create a live progress display.

symbols.name: _load_config
symbols.summary: Loads and merges configuration from YAML files, expanding environment variables.

symbols.name: _expand_env
symbols.summary: Expands environment variable references in a string.

symbols.name: _expand_config
symbols.summary: Recursively expands environment variables in configuration data structures.

symbols.name: _make_llm_client
symbols.summary: Creates and configures an OpenAI client from a configuration dictionary.

symbols.name: _read_diff
symbols.summary: Reads diff text from a file path or standard input.

symbols.name: run
symbols.signature: run(repo: str = typer.Option(..., "--repo", "-r", help="Path to the repository (after-version checkout)"), diff: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, "--diff", "-d", help="Path to .diff file, or '-' for stdin"), depth: Optional[int] = typer.Option(None, "--depth", help="BFS depth (default: from config, usually 2)"), model: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, "--model", "-m", help="LLM model override"), output: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, "--output", "-o", help="Write rendered context to file instead of stdout"), dump_graph: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, "--dump-graph", help="Write MetaModel as JSON array to file"), api_url: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, "--api-url", help="OpenAI-compatible API base URL override"), api_key: Optional[str] = typer.Option(None, "--api-key", help="API key override"))
symbols.summary: Main command to build a dependency graph from a diff and render a prompt context.

symbols.name: inspect
symbols.signature: inspect(diff: Optional[str] = typer.Argument(None, help="Path to .diff file, or '-' for stdin"))
symbols.summary: Parses a diff and displays a summary without using an LLM.

symbols.name: _print_diff_summary
symbols.summary: Prints a formatted table summarizing the parsed diff results.

symbols.name: _make_event_handler
symbols.summary: Creates a callback function to log progress events via a Rich Live display.

name: renderer
summary: Renders a MetaModel as a text prompt context for code review with compression and token budgeting.

dependencies.name: DiffResult
dependencies.usage: Used as an optional parameter in render() and _build() to include raw diff text and file statuses.

dependencies.name: MetaModel
dependencies.usage: Primary input parameter for render() and _build(), used to access modules, symbols, and compute dependency depths.

dependencies.name: Module
dependencies.usage: Used as a parameter type in _render_compressed() and _render_fallback() to access module properties like id, lang, and symbols.

dependencies.name: Symbol
dependencies.usage: Used as a list element type in _top_level_symbols() to filter symbols based on line ranges.

symbols.name: _OMIT
symbols.summary: Maps language names to their respective body omission markers for compressed rendering.

symbols.name: _COMMENT_CHAR
symbols.summary: Maps language names to their respective single-line comment characters.

symbols.name: _compressed_header
symbols.summary: Generates a header comment explaining the compressed file format for a given language.

symbols.name: render
symbols.signature: def render(model: MetaModel, diff_result: Optional[DiffResult] = None, repo_path: str = "", max_tokens: int = 8000) -> str
symbols.summary: Main entry point that renders a MetaModel as a text prompt, applying token budget degradation if necessary.

symbols.name: _build
symbols.signature: def _build(model: MetaModel, diff_result: Optional[DiffResult], repo_path: str, trunc2: bool, trunc1: bool) -> str
symbols.summary: Assembles the full prompt text from the model, diff, and file contents, applying compression based on flags.

symbols.name: _render_compressed
symbols.summary: Renders a compressed but readable view of a source file by omitting bodies of off-trace symbols.

symbols.name: _body_start
symbols.signature: def _body_start(lines: list[str], sig_0: int, end_0: int) -> int
symbols.summary: Finds the 0-based index of the first line of a symbol's body by scanning for signature closure.

symbols.name: _body_indent
symbols.signature: def _body_indent(lines: list[str], sig_0: int, end_0: int) -> int
symbols.summary: Determines the indentation level of the first non-blank line in a symbol's body.

symbols.name: _top_level_symbols
symbols.summary: Filters a list of symbols to return only those not nested inside another symbol.

symbols.name: _render_fallback
symbols.summary: Renders a module as pseudocode when the repository path is unavailable.

symbols.name: _build_dep_usage_index
symbols.summary: Builds a map from dependency file paths to their usage annotations for rendering.

symbols.name: _file_status
symbols.summary: Determines the status string for a file based on the diff result.

symbols.name: _token_estimate
symbols.summary: Estimates token count for a text string using a simple character ratio.

symbols.name: _tok
symbols.summary: Alias for the _token_estimate function.
